title: DurianOS data schema
description: Data contract for DurianOS (brief v0.2, 2026-10-14). Built from docs/durianos-erd.md and the brief. `$defs.tables` is the database design (32 tables, a design before migration, not a schema that has run). `$defs.entities` / `EntityCreate` / `EntityPatch` / `Mutation*` / `Snapshot` / `content` are the JSON the API and the app exchange. `x-` keys carry what JSON Schema cannot express (keys, unique indexes with their live-row filter, cross-row checks).

x-conventions.ids: Household rows have a client-generated uuid. Content rows have a server uuid (disease.code is a stable text key). Never use email as a key; AUTH_USER is the Auth subject.
x-conventions.bookkeeping: id, created_at, updated_at, revision, deleted_at on every household row; the server owns all but id.
x-conventions.ownership: Every child checks ownership through its FK chain to farm.owner_id (or media_asset.owner_id). RLS and the API enforce the same rule. owner_id is never read from the client.
x-conventions.softDelete: Household rows are tombstoned, not removed. Unique rules apply to live rows only (deleted_at IS NULL).
x-conventions.money: VND and VND/kg are numeric(18,2); kg is numeric(12,3). JSON uses decimal strings. null = unknown.
x-conventions.dates: `date` = farming day the farmer typed; timestamptz = UTC.
x-conventions.stableCodes: stage, kind, category, status, plant_part, outcome, contact kind are stable codes. Vietnamese / English labels live in the translation catalogs, not in rows.
x-conventions.versioning: Published content and any revision once referenced by a citation or self-check stay immutable.
x-conventions.revision: expected_revision is checked per record. Two phones editing the same record from one revision: the later mutation gets conflict. Independent records are accepted. There is no device lock.
x-conventions.localOnly: The phone's SQLite (outbox, local scan photos, read cache of farm/plot/season/open cases, content pack + FTS) is not a backend table and is not described here. Per brief v0.2 the outbox serves only Scan.

x-derivedMetrics.description: Computed, never stored. The phone and the backend use the same decimal rules; the backend result is canonical after sync.

arithmetic.decimal: No floats. Money rounds half-up to 0.01 VND after each multiplication; kg keep 3 decimals.
arithmetic.unknown: A missing input gives an unknown result (null), never 0.

metrics.recorded_cost: sum(expense.amount_vnd) over live expenses of the selected seasons
metrics.sales_value: sum(sale.total_vnd) over live CONFIRMED sales. Deposits and receipts do not raise it.
metrics.net_receipts: per sale: sum(deposit) + sum(receipt) - sum(refund) over live payments
metrics.provisional: Shown as 'not confirmed'. Excluded from sales_value and receivable.
metrics.no_netting: Receivable and refund due are shown per sale. Never offset across buyers.
metrics.forecast_profit: round_half_up(forecast_yield_kg * forecast_price_vnd_kg, 2) - forecast_total_cost_vnd; unknown if any input is null
metrics.closed_season: Still accepts payments for old debts. A new season inherits no debt.

x-externalTables.auth_user: Supabase Auth subject (uuid). Referenced by owner_id / user_id / reviewed_by.

Uuid.description: Household ids are created on the phone (UUID v4/v7).

Timestamp.description: UTC instant. The UI shows Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

DateString.description: Calendar day chosen by the farmer, YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).

Locale.description: Default vi. More languages must not change the business schema.

Score.description: Normalised 0-1. The UI may show a percentage; thresholds come from the model manifest.

Vnd.description: VND, numeric(18,2), as a decimal STRING. Never a JSON number. Computed money rounds half-up to 0.01. null means unknown, which is not 0.

Decimal.description: Non-negative decimal string (hectares). Precision is a proposal; the ERD fixes only 'not negative'.

ScanOutcome.description: Saved outcomes. The UI also has a fourth state, `error`, which is never saved or synced.

PlantPart.description: A body part that the bundled model manifest has a complete pipeline for (e.g. leaf). The set comes from the manifest, not from this schema.

ContentStatus.description: Proposed workflow. Only approved content can be published.

ChatReportStatus.description: Proposed values; the ERD only says `status`.

InferenceMetadata.description: Entries of the bundled manifest that produced the result. Additional keys are allowed.

source_locale.description: Language of the cited text, which can differ from the question language.

Citation.description: Points to the exact translation revision that was used. Never to a newer one.

Scan.description: A saved scan is an immutable snapshot. Only case_id may change (attach to or detach from a case of the same season).

answers.description: Replace-all: one mutation saves the whole checklist.

is_fallback.description: True when the version has no translation for the UI language and its own source text is shown. Never text from another version.

id.description: Stable inside the version. Ticks key on it.

StandardVersion.description: A translation is published only when it covers every item; otherwise the whole source text of this version is returned with is_fallback = true.

StandardProfile.description: CN/fresh and EU/fresh must exist. published_version_id = null renders the empty state, never sample items.

Contact.description: At least one of phone, zalo, contact_url is not null.

tombstones.description: Ids removed since the previous release.

ContentRelease.description: A whole approved release. The app downloads it to staging, checks the hash, then swaps it in atomically. A failed download keeps the previous release. Empty arrays are real: the app shows an empty state. Versions referenced by a citation or a self-check stay available.

MutationOp.description: One write. `data` carries business fields only; id, revision, timestamps and owner are server-owned.

mutation_id.description: One user action = one id. Keep it across retries.

Mutation.description: All ops commit together or not at all. Same mutation_id + same payload returns the first answer.

oneOf.title: applied
oneOf.description: Rows as written, with the new revisions.

oneOf.title: conflict
oneOf.description: revision_conflict (409 semantics). Nothing was written. `rows` are the server's current rows so the farmer can discard the local edit or re-enter it.

oneOf.title: rejected
oneOf.description: 422 semantics. Nothing was written. `code` is from the error-code catalog in api_contract.json. `field` is a dotted path like ops.1.data.amount_vnd.

results.description: One per request mutation, same order.

Snapshot.description: Everything the user has had acknowledged, tombstones (deleted_at != null) included, so a new or long-offline phone never revives a deleted row. Unsynced local data is not here.
